# Tumzy — low FODMAP food reference

> 310 foods rated low, moderate or high FODMAP, each with a substitute. Ratings follow the low-FODMAP protocol from Monash University. Servings matter: a food that is low in a normal portion can be high in a large one.

## Pages
- [Low FODMAP food list](https://perufitlife.github.io/gutsy/low-fodmap-food-list/): the full table, by category.
